geometry_strategy: Pre-export Blender consolidation joins the rigged body into one skinned mesh while keeping the curved reference face and semantic chimarrao prop nodes separate.
post_export: glTF-Transform 4.2.1 hierarchy flatten plus unused attribute pruning; no post-export mesh join, simplification, texture recompression, or geometry compression

profile.face: rosto quadrado-oval amplo, olhos azulados, nariz definido e assimetria cordial no sorriso
profile.hair: cabelo ruivo-claro curto, texturizado e levemente despenteado
profile.accessories: óculos grandes arredondados em metal dourado e chimarrão na mão esquerda
profile.clothing: terno azul profundo de alfaiataria, camisa branca, gravata verde e sapatos conhaque
profile.animation: postura sentada cordial, respiração fora de fase, mão direita na coxa e chimarrão estabilizado à esquerda

profile.face: rosto oval anguloso, mandíbula limpa, olhos castanhos próximos, nariz reto e sorriso discreto
profile.hair: cabelo castanho-escuro curto, volumoso no topo e penteado lateralmente
profile.clothing: terno grafite de alfaiataria ajustada, camisa branca, gravata verde e sapatos marrons
profile.animation: postura sentada madura, respiração discreta, mãos apoiadas nas coxas e pés firmes no piso

limitations: Procedural likeness is identity-specific but is not a photogrammetry or FACS facial scan.
A single curved projection from each versioned official portrait carries the frontal facial identity; extreme profile and cinematic close-up fidelity remain outside this map asset contract.
Garments are layered rigid-weight meshes with modeled thickness and tailoring; real-time cloth simulation is intentionally omitted.
Hair and beard use lightweight geometric clumps rather than strand-hair simulation.
Visual QA is calibrated for the Commercial Map camera; the assets are not scan-grade cinematic close-up humans.
